basic_info.description: Beautifully updated duplex in SFs with newer electrical & plumbing systems in prime Excelsior neighborhood, perfect for multi-generational living, owner occupancy, or investment. The lower unit ft. a spacious living area, guest bedroom, renovated full bath, and large primary bedroom. The open eat-in kitchen includes cherry wood cabinets, granite countertops & recessed lighting w/ brand-new fixtures throughout. A rear laundry/pantry room adds convenience and extra storage potential. Upstairs, revamped entry leads to 3 sizable bedrooms, a designer-tiled bathroom w. stall shower, and an open kitchen w. birchwood cabinets, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances & recessed lighting. A second laundry/pantry room completes the space & enhances the functionality for tenants/extended family. Enjoy views of Mt. Davidson & Twin Peaks; relax in the fully manicured backyard w. fruitful plum tree, pruned camellias, paved paths & fresh mulch. Additional highlights include luxury Pergo flooring, fresh interior/exterior paint, 2 basement storage areas, and a prime location near McLaren Park, Mission St, local shops, eateries, and public transit. Easy access to I-280 and I-101 makes commuting to Downtown SF or Silicon Valley a breeze. Dont miss this versatile and well-located opportunity!
